name: Ducati Multistrada 1200
engine: 1198 cc liquid-cooled Testastretta L-twin (DVT from 2015), fuel injected
intro: Ducati's adventure sport tourer. Early bikes had several recalls, including a throttle cable recall on every 2010-2014 bike.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2010 bikes are in recalls 10V356 (throttle cable cable tie) and 10V358 (steering head screw). 2010-2011 bikes are in recall 11V253 (electronic steering lock). 2010-2014 bikes are in recall 15V152 (throttle cable sleeve can stop the throttle closing).
A-002.reason: A throttle that won't close is a crash risk. Every fix is free.

add.title: Check the timing belts and desmo valve clearances
add.instructions: Replace the cam timing belts on schedule, by age as well as miles, and check the desmo opening and closing clearances. Old belts can snap and wreck the engine.
add.reason: Ducati belt-drive twins need belts changed on time even if the bike sat.

recalls.what: Throttle cables can rub on the radiator edge.
Wrong screw may have been fitted in the steering head.
Electronic steering lock may not release at key-on.
recalls.fix: Dealer updates the hands-free unit software free.

recalls.what: Throttle cable inner sleeve may move and stop the throttle from fully closing.
